quote_json: "An instance member of the struct is referenced."
notes: The hosted execution leaves the external startup counter at zero after a reference to the struct instance field. The static constructor increments that counter and the required value after the reference is one. The positive witness calls an explicitly declared constructor before reading the field and observes the required counter and field values at ISO-1 and C# 7.3. The difference is static-constructor triggering; the field-default and observation mechanisms pass in the positive control. At ISO-2, ECMA-334 4th ed 18.3.10, p. 335 (PDF p. 357) requires this result. Reading the instance field triggers the struct static constructor under the fourth rule. Merely creating the default value is not the tested trigger; the subsequent field access must make the count one.
